name: Human
description: Humans are the most adaptable and ambitious people among the common species. Their short life spans push them to achieve as much as they can in the years they are given.

traits.name: Resourceful
traits.description: You gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a Long Rest.

traits.name: Skillful
traits.description: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

traits.name: Versatile
traits.description: You gain an Origin feat of your choice.

name: Elf
description: Elves are a magical people of otherworldly grace, living in places of ethereal beauty. They love nature and magic, art and artistry, music and poetry.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Elven Lineage
traits.description: You are part of a lineage that grants you supernatural abilities. Choose one of the following lineages: Drow (Drow spellcasting), High Elf (a Wizard cantrip and Detect Magic), or Wood Elf (35 ft speed and Longstrider).

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: You have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Charmed condition.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Insight or Perception skill.

traits.name: Trance
traits.description: You don't need to sleep, and magic can't put you to sleep. You can finish a Long Rest in 4 hours if you spend those hours in a trancelike meditation, during which you retain consciousness.

name: Dwarf
description: Dwarves are solid and enduring like the mountains they love, weathering centuries with stoic determination and a fierce commitment to clan and tradition.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 120 feet.

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.description: You have Resistance to Poison damage. You also have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Poisoned condition.

traits.name: Dwarven Toughness
traits.description: Your Hit Point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 again whenever you gain a level.

traits.name: Stonecunning
traits.description: As a Bonus Action, you gain Tremorsense with a range of 60 feet for 10 minutes. You can use this Bonus Action a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

name: Halfling
description: Halflings are a small folk who lead lives of quiet comfort, favoring settled communities and the simple pleasures of hearth and home.

traits.name: Brave
traits.description: You have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Frightened condition.

traits.name: Halfling Nimbleness
traits.description: You can move through the space of any creature that is of a Size larger than yours.

traits.name: Luck
traits.description: When you roll a 1 on the d20 of a D20 Test, you can reroll the die, and you must use the new roll.

traits.name: Naturally Stealthy
traits.description: You can take the Hide action even when you are obscured only by a creature that is at least one Size larger than you.

name: Gnome
description: Gnomes are magical folk created by gods of the Feywild. They are small, clever, and endlessly curious, delighting in invention, exploration, and trickery.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Gnomish Cunning
traits.description: You have Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

traits.name: Gnomish Lineage
traits.description: You are part of a lineage that grants you supernatural abilities. Choose one of the following: Forest Gnome (Minor Illusion cantrip and speak with Small beasts) or Rock Gnome (Mending and Prestidigitation cantrips).

name: Dragonborn
description: Dragonborn are humanoids who look very much like dragons standing erect in humanoid form, though they lack wings or a tail. They were created by the dragon god Bahamut.

traits.name: Draconic Ancestry
traits.description: Your lineage stems from a dragon progenitor. Choose the kind of dragon from the Draconic Ancestors table (Black, Blue, Brass, Bronze, Copper, Gold, Green, Red, Silver, or White). Your choice affects your Breath Weapon and Damage Resistance.

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.description: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can replace one of your attacks with an exhalation of magical energy in either a 15-foot Cone or a 30-foot Line that is 5 feet wide (your choice each time). Each creature in that area must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC = 8 + Constitution modifier + Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, a creature takes 1d10 damage of the type determined by your Draconic Ancestry. On a successful save, a creature takes half damage. This damage increases: 2d10 at level 5, 3d10 at level 11, 4d10 at level 17.

traits.name: Damage Resistance
traits.description: You have Resistance to the damage type determined by your Draconic Ancestry.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Draconic Flight
traits.description: When you reach character level 5, you can channel draconic magic to give yourself temporary flight. As a Bonus Action, you sprout spectral wings on your back that last for 10 minutes or until you retract them. During that time you have a Fly Speed equal to your Speed. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

name: Goliath
description: Goliaths are towering humanoids with a connection to the magic of giants. They are competitive and driven to outdo their past performances, pushing themselves to ever-greater feats of strength.

traits.name: Giant Ancestry
traits.description: You are descended from Giants. Choose one of the following benefits — a benefit associated with Cloud, Fire, Frost, Hill, Stone, or Storm Giants: Cloud (use Misty Step), Fire (fire resistance), Frost (cold resistance), Hill (resistance to being knocked prone or pushed), Stone (can manifest stone armor as a Bonus Action), Storm (lightning resistance and Thunder resistance).

traits.name: Large Form
traits.description: Starting at character level 5, you can change your size to Large as a Bonus Action if you're in a big enough space. This lasts for 10 minutes or until you end it (no action required). For that duration, you have Advantage on Strength checks, and your Speed increases by 10 feet. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.description: You have Advantage on any saving throw you make to end the Grappled condition. You also count as one Size larger when determining your carrying capacity.

name: Orc
description: Orcs trace their creation to Gruumsh, the one-eyed god of storms. They are rugged, resilient folk whose fortitude and determination are unmatched among the peoples of the multiverse.

traits.name: Adrenaline Rush
traits.description: You can take the Dash action as a Bonus Action. When you do so, you gain a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Short or Long Rest.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 120 feet.

traits.name: Relentless Endurance
traits.description: When you are reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 Hit Point instead. Once you use this trait, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

name: Tiefling
description: Tieflings are either combated born from fiendish bloodlines or transformed by otherworldly power. They bear the marks of their infernal heritage in their appearance.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Fiendish Legacy
traits.description: You are the recipient of a fiendish legacy that grants you supernatural abilities. Choose a legacy from the following: Abyssal (poison-related spells), Chthonic (necrotic-related spells), or Infernal (fire-related spells). You gain associated cantrips and spells at levels 1, 3, and 5.

traits.name: Otherworldly Presence
traits.description: You know the Thaumaturgy cantrip. When you cast it with this trait, the spell uses the same spellcasting ability you use for your Fiendish Legacy trait.

name: Aasimar
description: Aasimar are mortals who carry a spark of the Upper Planes within their souls. They can fan that spark to bring light, ease wounds, and unleash the fury of the heavens.

traits.name: Celestial Resistance
traits.description: You have Resistance to Necrotic damage and Radiant damage.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Healing Hands
traits.description: As a Magic action, you touch a creature and roll a number of d4s equal to your Proficiency Bonus. The creature regains a number of Hit Points equal to the total rolled. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

traits.name: Light Bearer
traits.description: You know the Light cantrip. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for it.

traits.name: Celestial Revelation
traits.description: When you reach character level 3, you can transform as a Bonus Action using one of the options below (choose each time you transform): Heavenly Wings (spectral wings with Fly Speed equal to your Speed), Inner Radiance (searing light deals Radiant damage to nearby creatures at end of your turns), or Necrotic Shroud (frightening aura forces Wisdom saves). The transformation lasts for 1 minute and adds extra damage to one attack or spell per turn. Once you transform, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest.
